video.native_audio_policy: Request no speech/music/effects; mute or discard provider audio during assembly. Use the separate Arthur/Sol takes. No unsupported sound toggle.

production_order: Generate first and last stills for a scene.
Show BOTH actual stills to the user and obtain explicit approval of that exact pair.
Pass the frame gate, then animate the approved pair using Gemini Omni Flash 1.2.
Run independent clip review against the approved pair, scene contract and original lantern reference.
Use only passing clips in production. Preserve failed and uncertain takes.
verification: Model ID, paired-frame input roles, 3–10 second paired-frame limit and 1080p output verified with Higgsfield models_search.
